status_note: Look-dev v2 (2026-09-29): the H3 game model of Harpy moved onto the UM material library v1 for M_UM_Figure_v2 (docs/art-pipeline/material-library/README.md, m-um-figure-v2.md): MatID (R8, index x 16 + 8, no mips), hero LUT 16 x 16 RGBA16F (build_ue_inputs.py layout, rows 0-9), UV1 in metres, EdgeMask, TeamAccent (new, docs/art-pipeline/material-library/team-accent.md); the W4-B TeamMask stays byte-identical and is deprecated. Geometry, UV0, rig and weights are those of the H3 run (appended from its work/h2-candidate.blend and checked against its FBX). Status: measured (Blender frames only), not art acceptance; UE import is the next stage.

source.note: read only: work/bake/*.npy, work/uv-labels.npz, work/uv-tris.npz (local, git-ignored) are hard-linked into a scratch run and textures.py of the module is replayed unchanged; its 4K/2K PNGs must equal the H3 textures-report (check h3_state_reproduced). work/h2-candidate.blend is appended by ld_fbx / ld_review

lookdev.matid_px_note: MatID at the runtime atlas size 2K as Merlin (LDM-4) and Medusa (LDD-10): the talons and the bracelet cord are 20-60 texel features at 2K; 4K master local

hero_slots.note: horn_claw is an extension class of the library (no global MatID, README §3a): Harpy has no brass, so its LUT column 5 carries horn_claw (all fields, detail slice 14 = stone_base tiles); the MatID of the talons is 5 x 16 + 8 = 88. ART-016 (2026-10-04, look-dev r3.3): feathers_flight (the dark primaries, extension 17) in the unused column 3 (metal_forged: all fields of the extension, detail slice 12 = feathers tiles), MatID 3 x 16 + 8 = 56; column 3 because its DebugView colour is the farthest from every other Harpy class colour (the UE zone decode, review-config debug_calibration)

classes.default_note: every texel of the figure is keratin feather or keratin scale unless a rule below takes it: the feet parts (scaled tarsus) are feathers too (same F0 0.046, matte 0.55; no scale class in v1)

skin.note: H3 skin weight (textures.materials.feathers.skin: head part, v >= 0.45, s <= 0.4) >= 0.5; holes of the skin inside the face islands (brows, eyes, lip line: dark painted features) are filled, so the face is one skin class

horn_claw.note: H3 talon weight (textures.materials.talons: feet parts, s <= 0.3, v <= 0.4, opened 3 px) >= 0.5

feathers_flight.note: ART-016 (2026-10-04, look-dev r3.3): feather texels under the H3 dark-primary mask (the W4-B TeamMask the r2 / 5c-B0 albedo edits use, weighted) >= 0.5 -> their own class, so the LUT gives the primaries specular 0.35 and the rufous feathers keep 0.575. Applied after every BC edit (those select feathers x mask, so the BC bytes do not change); components smaller than min_component_px go back to feathers

bracelet.note: the band of part 13 is z 0.1430-0.1740 (source frame; measured 2026-09-29: metallic mean 0.75-0.91 inside, 0.04 / 0.17 in the lowest / highest decile = leg scales of the same part -> feathers). Concept: two gold rims and a central braid (~55 % of the height). The central half of the band becomes the team-colour cord inset (leather_smooth: dyeable dielectric; metals are never dyed, rule 5c-A), the rims stay gold_antique
bracelet.cord_tone: dark leather: the Tripo BC of the braid texels scaled so the cord median luminance = the median luminance of the wing accent texels (one TeamDyeGain gives both the same team colour)

classes.dielectric_clamp_note: clamp(Y, lo, hi) of the v2 core applied in the texture (not the Medusa toe): measured 2026-09-29, the toe lifted every feather texel below Y 0.04 (41 % of the feathers) and the Cobble K2 dark share of the body fell from 17 % (H3) to 11 % against 34 % of the concept; the hard clamp moves only the texels below the albedo floor 0.02

luminance_range_hero.note: look-dev round 2 (2026-09-30): the dark primaries carry an effective albedo below the preset feather floor 0.02 (ue_feedback_r2 dark_primaries, Y p50 0.0201 -> 0.0138); the hero LUT feathers luminanceMin (lut_overrides) is 0.008, so the v2 core does not lift them back; the texture clamp itself stays the preset one (the other feather texels are unchanged); used by the check dielectric_bc_in_class_range

dark_primaries.source: 5c-B0 (2026-09-30): UE look-dev C frames i3 (art/pipeline-candidates/ASSET-HARPY-001/20260929-h3ld-ue/review/i3, UE LUT i3: feathers luminance [0.02, 0.7], maxChannel 0.9) against the concept; tools/art/material_library/ue_bc_feedback.py fit (zone dark, pixels = the value gate v <= 0.45 of the zone AND sat < 0.38 on the board frame: the dark primaries without the shaded rufous coverts the gate also takes, sat 0.4-0.7; keep-luma fit (0.862, 1.1607, 1.2304) scaled x 0.9 -> ratio of the effective albedo (0.7758, 1.0446, 1.1074), the scale that keeps every other zone's verdict (the exposure k moves with the dark zone, a key zone)); gain = ue_bc_feedback.py gain on the 2K BC of the feather class under the H3 dark-primary mask (T_Harpy_H3LD_TeamMask, deprecated W4-B mask), 31 % of those texels on the 0.02 floor
dark_primaries.why: UE i3: the dark primaries read brown-rust (sat +0.16 on the reading exposure -1 EV, +0.12 on the board), the concept is near grey (50 45 43, sat 0.14); rufous coverts and dark primaries share the feathers class, so the LUT has no separate lever. Predicted after: -1 EV Y 1.06 / sat +0.02 / hue within (in tolerance), board Y 1.23 / sat +0.005 (luminance = board light, as before 1.24); rufous feathers, skin, gold, claws keep their verdicts (reports/ld-5cb0-ue-feedback.json)

ue_feedback.note: BC gain of the H3 dark-primary mask texels of the feather class (lookdev_maps.py, before the class luminance clamp)

ue_feedback_r2.name: dark_primaries_r2
ue_feedback_r2.source: look-dev round 2 (2026-09-30): converged UE frames b1 of 5c-B1 (art/pipeline-candidates/ASSET-HARPY-001/20260929-h3ld-ue/review/b1, warm-up 0.55, rev 5, reading -0.75 EV), review config r2 (concept dark zone without the grey-blue studio backdrop: concept-zones-r2.json; UE dark zone = the outer-wing region of the concept boxes: render_regions.dark); tools/art/material_library/lookdev_r2.py fit --zones dark,skin (weights reading 1 / neutral 0.5) -> ratio of the effective albedo (0.703, 0.6689, 0.6765); requested (0.674, 0.634, 0.661) so that the 8-bit sRGB 2K BC realises it (at Y ~0.014 one sRGB level is ~7 % linear; first pass 0.70/0.67/0.68 realised 0.730/0.707/0.696): realised on the 2K texels under the H3 dark mask (0.6957, 0.6698, 0.6964), Y p50 0.0201 -> 0.0138
ue_feedback_r2.why: b1 with the aligned zone definition: the dark primaries match the concept in saturation (-0.006) but are 1.47x too bright relative to the rufous feathers and skin; 89 % of their texels sit on the preset floor 0.02 (5c-B0), so only a lower hero floor lets the albedo go down (luminance_range_hero, lut_overrides feathers luminanceMin 0.008)

ue_feedback_r2.name: skin_r2
ue_feedback_r2.source: same fit (skin 1.3234, 1.3987, 1.4821), rounded; realised on the 2K skin texels (1.3246, 1.3975, 1.4725)
ue_feedback_r2.why: b1: the face 0.83 (old zone definition) / 0.73 (aligned) of the concept at -0.75 EV and 0.77 / 0.67 at EV100 1.3, sat +0.06: lighter and less red (concept 158 133 108); skin texels are above the floor 0.08 (2 %), so the ratio acts 1:1

ue_feedback_r3.name: skin_r3
ue_feedback_r3.source: look-dev round 3 iteration r3.2 (2026-09-30): UE capture b3.1 (art/pipeline-candidates/ASSET-HARPY-001/20260929-h3ld-ue/review/b3.1, LUT r3.1: feathers specular 0.35, gold F0 x1.15) against the concept; uniform (chromaticity kept)
ue_feedback_r3.why: b3.1: the lower feather specular darkened the whole-figure dark zone of the 5c-B1 definition (0.94 -> 0.78), the key-zone exposure k moved 0.97 -> 1.10 and the face read 1.23 (5c-B1 zones; r2 zones 1.08). Skin is a key zone in both definitions: x0.85 lowers it by 0.85^(2/3) relative to k in both (5c-B1 ~1.10, r2 ~0.97)

team_accent.dark_mask: the W4-B TeamMask of H3 (dark flight feathers, v <= 0.22, ramp 0.05, blur 3 x 3)

dye.note: UE: dyed = TeamColor x Y(BC) x TeamDyeGain (TeamDye 1); TeamDyeGain = min(0.8 / median Y, 0.9 / (p95 Y x max channel of the palette)) of the accent texels -> the accent median reads close to the team colour and the brightest 5 % of the dyed albedo stay <= 0.9

team_accent.note: TeamAccent = the tips of the dark primaries along the wing outline (dark mask x distance to the frontal XZ silhouette <= 2.5 cm source = 1.6 cm final, 4 mm soft) + the bracelet cord. The feathers keep the concept colours; the old TeamMask (all dark flight feathers, 14-16 %) is kept byte-identical for compatibility and deprecated

edge.note: as Medusa look-dev: convexity of the baked tangent normal (div n.xy / metres per texel, final frame), smoothstep

feathers.note: look-dev round 2 (2026-09-30): hero floor below the preset 0.02 for the dark primaries (classes.luminance_range_hero, ue_feedback_r2 dark_primaries_r2); every other feather texel is >= 0.02 in the texture, so the v2 core shows the texture. Kept after the r3.3 split: the mask-edge texels (dark weight < 0.5, partly darkened by r2) stay feathers

feathers_flight.note: ART-016 (r3.3): the same hero floor as feathers for the primaries (their effective albedo Y p50 0.0138 lies below the preset 0.02); written into the slot column metal_forged

gold_antique.note: hero F0 = concept tone (ld_compose gold_tone). Iteration 0 = preset F0 (1.0, 0.766, 0.336): LD render gold hue 47 deg / S 0.36 / luma 132 against the concept 33 deg / 0.66 / 124 (front + back framing, preview light); suggestion iteration 1 = (1.0, 0.4371, 0.1032), Y 0.533

uv1.method: per UV0 island: UV1 = (UV0 - centre of the island bbox) x s, s = sqrt(area3D / areaUV0) (final frame metres per UV unit); no rotation, no mirror (Medusa look-dev); centred for UE half-float UVs

concept_zones.note: boxes [x0, y0, x1, y1] in concept pixels (1470 x 1070, the H3 concept framing of review_h3.py = these pixels) + an HSV filter on the concept pixel; the render side takes the pixels of the class in the same box from the ID pass
concept_zones.reference_note: the feather BC is unchanged from H3 (concept colours): the concept / render ratio of the feather zones measures the light and exposure difference of the two images, the gold ratio is divided by it (as steelcheck.py of Arthur H2.2 uses the base stone and the red cloth)
